Modules List

Here is a list of all modules with brief descriptions:
cropequCrop the equilibrium
culhamTranslation of efit equilibrium data into dg-compatible format
dg2dgRefine the equilibrium a factor of 2 in both directions using splines
dg2efTranslation of dg-compatible equilibrium data into efit format
dg2vrTranslation of TdeV equilibrium data into dg-compatible format
dg_arith_dgShift of the magnetic flux by a specified increment
dg_minuspsi_dgChange the sign of the flux
dg_proc_dgDo arbitrary re-processing of the equilibrium --- in this case chop off the first few columns
diva2dgTranslation of Diva equilibrium data into dg-compatible format
ef2dgTranslation of efit equilibrium data into dg-compatible format
JETPPF2DGTranslation of the JET PPF equilibrium data into dg-compatible format
jt2dgTranslation of efit equilibrium data into dg-compatible format
nk2dgTranslation of equilibrium data from Naka to dg-compatible format
nkn2dgTranslation of equilibrium data from Naka to dg-compatible format
pb2dgTranslation of equilibrium data from P. Barabasci into dg-compatible format
prinequPrintout of dg-compatible equilibrium data in a table
pt2dgConversion of equilibrium file produced with PROTEUS into DG format (courtesy Prof. O. de Barbieri)
risepsiShift of the magnetic flux by a specified increment
shotfile2dgTranslation of the AUG shotfile equilibrium data into dg-compatible format
sst2dgTranslation of efit equilibrium data into dg-compatible format
vr2dgTranslation of TdeV equilibrium data into dg-compatible format
